title: 110 Great Questions to Ask a Girl (Fun, Deep & Romantic)
h1: 110 Great Questions to Ask a Girl: Fun, Deep and Romantic
description: Need great questions to ask a girl? Here are 110 fun, random, deep and romantic questions for first dates, texting and getting closer — plus how to use them.
keyword: great questions to ask a girl
excerpt: 110 questions for every stage — first date icebreakers, random fun, deep conversation starters and romantic questions — plus tips for asking them naturally.
intro:
The best conversations don't happen by accident. They usually start with one good question that opens a door — and then genuine curiosity that walks through it. Whether you're on a first date, texting someone new or trying to know your girlfriend on a deeper level, the right question can turn small talk into real connection.

Below you'll find 110 great questions to ask a girl, grouped by mood and stage: light first-date icebreakers, random and playful questions, deeper ones about values and dreams, and romantic questions for when you're already close. Start with a quick guide to asking them so they feel like a conversation, not an interview.
body:
How to use these questions (without sounding like a quiz)

  • Match the moment. Save deep and romantic questions for when you've built some comfort. Early on, keep things light and fun.
  • Follow up. The second question matters more than the first. “Why?” “What was that like?” and “Tell me more” show you're listening.
  • Answer too. Share your own answer so it feels like an exchange, not an interrogation.
  • Let her skip. If a question lands awkwardly, laugh it off and move on. Nobody owes you an answer.
  • Pick three, not thirty. One good thread can carry a whole evening.
Tip: Listen for the answer that makes her light up — a hobby, a place, a person — and stay there. Enthusiasm is the best sign you've found a great topic.

First date questions to break the ice

  1. What's the best thing that happened to you this week?
  2. What do you do when you have a totally free Saturday?
  3. What's something you're really into right now?
  4. Where did you grow up, and what did you love about it?
  5. What's your go-to comfort food?
  6. What's the last show you binge-watched?
  7. Are you a morning person or a night owl?
  8. What's a skill you've always wanted to learn?
  9. Coffee, tea or neither?
  10. What's the best trip you've ever taken?
  11. Do you have any pets — or a dream pet?
  12. What kind of music do you put on when you're driving?
  13. What's a small thing that instantly makes your day better?
  14. What's your favorite way to spend a rainy day?
  15. Which of your friends would you call first with big news?
  16. What's something you're looking forward to this month?
  17. What's the best meal you've had recently?
  18. Are you more of a beach, city or mountains person?

Want more date-night conversation ideas? See our full list of first date questions and second date questions.

Random and fun questions to ask a girl

  1. If you could have any superpower for one day, what would it be?
  2. What's the weirdest food combination you secretly love?
  3. If your life had a theme song, what would it be?
  4. Which fictional character do you think you'd be best friends with?
  5. What's the most useless talent you have?
  6. If you could live in any decade, which would you pick?
  7. What's a hill you're willing to die on?
  8. Pineapple on pizza: yes or absolutely not?
  9. If you were a ghost, who would you haunt and why?
  10. What's your most irrational fear?
  11. What would your ideal theme park ride be like?
  12. If animals could talk, which would be the rudest?
  13. What's the funniest thing you've ever seen happen in public?
  14. What's the strangest dream you remember?
  15. If you could instantly master an instrument, which one?
  16. What's the worst haircut you've ever had?
  17. Which emoji do you use way too much?
  18. What would you name a boat if you owned one?
  19. If you had to eat one cuisine forever, which would it be?
  20. What's the most spontaneous thing you've ever done?
  21. Would you rather explore space or the deep ocean?
  22. What's a trend you never understood?
  23. If you opened a small business tomorrow, what would it sell?
  24. What's your karaoke song?
  25. Which celebrity would you want to cook dinner with?
  26. What's the best gift you've ever received?

Questions to get to know her better

  1. What's something most people don't know about you?
  2. What did you want to be when you were a kid?
  3. Who has had the biggest influence on your life?
  4. What are you most proud of so far?
  5. What does a perfect day look like for you, start to finish?
  6. What's one thing you're trying to get better at?
  7. How do your friends describe you?
  8. What's a book, movie or song that changed how you see things?
  9. What's your favorite family tradition?
  10. What's something you can talk about for hours?
  11. What's the best piece of advice you've ever been given?
  12. What do you like most about where you live?
  13. When do you feel most like yourself?
  14. What's a place that feels like home to you, besides home?
  15. What's something you changed your mind about recently?
  16. How do you like to recharge after a long week?

Deep questions to ask a girl

  1. What does happiness mean to you right now?
  2. What's a goal you haven't told many people about?
  3. What's something you've overcome that shaped who you are?
  4. What do you value most in a friendship?
  5. What are you most afraid of missing out on in life?
  6. If you could relive one day, which would you choose?
  7. What's a lesson you had to learn the hard way?
  8. What makes you feel truly understood?
  9. What would you do if you knew you couldn't fail?
  10. What's a belief you hold that most people disagree with?
  11. How have you changed in the past five years?
  12. What do you want people to remember about you?
  13. What's something you wish you could tell your younger self?
  14. When was the last time you felt really proud of yourself?
  15. What does a meaningful life look like to you?
  16. What's the kindest thing a stranger has ever done for you?
  17. What's something you're still figuring out?
  18. How do you handle it when life doesn't go to plan?
  19. Who do you go to when you need honest advice?
  20. What's one thing you'd never compromise on?

Romantic questions to ask a girl

  1. What's your idea of a perfect date?
  2. When did you first realize you liked me?
  3. What's the most romantic thing anyone has ever done for you?
  4. How do you like to be shown love?
  5. What's a small gesture that means a lot to you?
  6. What's your favorite memory of us so far?
  7. Do you believe in love at first sight?
  8. What song makes you think of romance?
  9. Where would you go if we could take a trip tomorrow?
  10. What's something you'd love for us to try together?
  11. What makes you feel most appreciated?
  12. What's your favorite way to spend a lazy day together?
  13. Which couple, real or fictional, do you admire?
  14. What do you think makes a relationship last?
  15. What's something I do that makes you smile?
  16. How do you like to celebrate special occasions?
  17. What's one thing you've always wanted a partner to know about you?
  18. What's a dream you'd love us to chase together?

For more ways to deepen things, try our would you rather questions for couples or, if she's still a crush, things to talk about with your crush.

Questions to ask a girl over text

  1. What's the highlight of your day so far?
  2. Send me the last photo you took — no context allowed.
  3. What are you listening to right now?
  4. What's one thing that made you laugh today?
  5. What's on your weekend wish list?
  6. Rate your day out of ten — and explain the score.
  7. What's a song you've had on repeat lately?
  8. If you could teleport somewhere for an hour, where would you go?
  9. What's your current comfort show?
  10. What's something you're excited about this week?
  11. Which would you choose right now: pizza, tacos or sushi?
  12. What's the best thing you've eaten today?

Questions to avoid early on

Some topics can feel too heavy or too personal before trust is built. Generally skip, at least at first:

  • Detailed questions about her exes or past relationships
  • How much she earns or what she owns
  • Questions about her body or appearance beyond a sincere compliment
  • Pushy questions about marriage or kids on a first date
  • Anything that sounds like a test or a trick

These can all come up naturally later if she chooses to share. Let her lead.

The bottom line

Great questions to ask a girl aren't about being clever — they're about being curious. Choose a few that fit the moment, share your own answers and follow the thread wherever her enthusiasm leads. Do that, and you'll learn far more than any list can give you. For more conversation help, see how to keep a conversation going.
takeaways: Match the question to the stage: light early, deeper once trust is built.
Follow-up questions and sharing your own answers matter more than the opening question.
Watch for topics that make her light up and stay with them.
Avoid heavy topics like exes, money and her body early on.
A few good questions beat rapid-fire interviews every time.

faq.q: What are good questions to ask a girl on a first date?
faq.a: Keep them light and open-ended: what she loves doing on weekends, the best trip she has taken, what she is excited about right now, or her favorite comfort food. These invite stories rather than one-word answers and give you natural follow-up questions to keep the conversation flowing.

faq.q: What are deep questions to ask a girl?
faq.a: Ask about her values, goals and experiences: what happiness means to her, a lesson she learned the hard way, what makes her feel understood or what she would do if she could not fail. Save these for when you have built some comfort, and share your own answers too.

faq.q: How do I ask a girl questions without it feeling like an interview?
faq.a: Ask one question, then really listen and follow up on what she says. Share your own answer, add a related story and let the conversation wander. Aim for a back-and-forth exchange rather than rapid-fire questions, and drop any topic she seems unenthusiastic about.

faq.q: What questions should you not ask a girl?
faq.a: Early on, avoid detailed questions about her exes, her income, her body or her plans for marriage and kids. Also skip trick questions or tests. These topics can come up naturally later once there is trust, ideally when she chooses to bring them up.
